text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's economy will not grow at the required pace unless major investments are undertaken in human resource development strategies.
- Zimbabwe's higher education ministry needs an additional Z$46 million in its scholarship department to finance students studying abroad and locally.
- The country's fertiliser industry is well equipped to provide 500,000 tonnes of the product which will be needed by commercial and small scale farmers during the current agricultural season.
